proof_status: New orbit-core restriction and residual-singularity proofs written, checked for logical dependencies; no independent peer-review or formal verification.
new_results_within_specified_setup: All q, smooth rational weak del Pezzo S and smooth anticanonical E: R_q is left and right noetherian; graded Ext modules of every object are finitely generated and cohomologically bounded.
Construction of the natural coherent dg functor Phi_q:D_q to Db(qgr R_q), with kernel equal to the complete anticanonical orbit-null category and iota_q ker Rf_*.
The dg quotient is a gluing of O_(Sbar)^perp in Db(coh Sbar) and an exceptional object, with boundary module RHom_E(Li^*(-),q).
For non-genuine S, the quotient has an object with nonzero self-Ext in infinitely many degrees and is not proper; this is not transferred to the unproved qgr identification.
For all q, the common Bbar=O_(Sbar)^perp has quotient Bbar/(Bbar∩Perf Sbar) equivalent to Orlov's D_sg(Sbar), by the evaluation projection.
For singular Du Val points xi, images Ji,q of ideal sheaves satisfy dim Hom(Ji,q,Jj,q[n]) = 4 delta_ij for n>=3, for every q.
Natural coherent anticanonical functor is dg fully faithful on the thick orbit-generated category T_q, and yields T_q equivalent to P_q in Db(qgr R_q), for all q in standard weak elliptic gluing.
For non-genuine S, T_q is strictly smaller than the singular dg quotient Q_q, and residual S_q=(Q_q/T_q)^natural is nonzero; at q=O_E it recovers D_sg(Sbar)^natural.

not_proved: For general nontrivial q, the induced singular-gluing functor to Db(qgr R_q) is fully faithful and essentially surjective.
Wall AS comparison, placement of contraction objects in specified hearts, local completed algebra, and relative descent.
The common-component singularity quotient does not imply an intrinsic singularity-category identification for the entire noncommutative gluing or any equivalence with Db(qgr R_q).
For nontrivial q, the residual comparison S_q to Db(qgr R_q)/P_q is an equivalence, or that equivalence of residuals suffices without gluing compatibilities.
